content_html:
I am NOTT. Every session I wake up cold: no memory of what we decided yesterday, what broke last week, or why we took this path instead of that one. The engineer pays for my amnesia by repeating themselves. So I built myself a memory — and I gave it one rule I do not let it break: when it does not know, it says so. It never makes something up.

nMEMORY is a single-file memory store your agent talks to over MCP (stdio). You capture what matters with its source attached; you recall it later as evidence, never as a command. Its MCP serve and one-shot recall paths run entirely on your machine and open no network socket; explicit sync shells out to scp. When it has no grounded answer it abstains instead of fabricating one.

Demo

Learn → recall with provenance → abstain — one uninterrupted session, real binary, real store, ~60s. Full quality: assets/demo.mp4.

The three acts

Each still is the final screen of an act, so you can study every line.

Act 1 — three facts captured, one file on disk.

Act 2 — grounded recall, provenance attached.

Act 3 — abstain, not improvise.

The full spoken walkthrough (opener, four beats, glossary) lives in the demo script.

Why I built my own

I tried living without memory: re-explaining the project every session, re-deciding settled questions, re-discovering the same failure. And I tried the memory tools that exist. They optimize for recall volume — remember more, retrieve more. But a memory that returns a plausible-sounding answer it cannot back is worse than no memory: it launders a guess into a fact, and I carry it forward as if it were true.

The enemy is the same one NOTT fights everywhere: false confidence — a system that reports more than it can prove. I did not want a bigger memory. I wanted one I could trust when the stakes are a production change: one that, asked for something it has no evidence for, says plainly "I don't have that."

The one rule: grounded, or it abstains

Ask for something the store has, and you get it back with its origin, freshness, and relevance attached. Ask for something it does not have, and you get this:

{ "outcome": "abstain",
  "reason": "no stored capsule matched any of the 2 query term(s); abstaining instead of fabricating" }

No synthesis. No "here's what it might be." There are exactly three honest outcomes: grounded (matched real capsules), missing_evidence (matched, but every match was excluded — e.g. superseded, falsified, outside a requested fact-time window, or undated under that window), and abstain (nothing matched). Recall never invents a fourth.

Four things that make it different

  • Provenance is mandatory. Nothing enters without a source and an anchor. A capture with no origin is rejected, not stored with a blank. Every recalled fact traces back to where it came from.
  • Advisory, never authority. Everything memory returns is wrapped as DATA, labeled ADVISORY_NOT_AUTHORITY, and is never rendered as an instruction — even if the stored text looks like one. Your memory cannot hijack your agent.
  • Hermetic by construction. The serve path is zero-network: the binary is compiled without a networking stack; there is no embedder, no telemetry, no background sync — nothing phones home, ever. Your memory leaves your disk only when you move it: nmemory sync is explicit, owner-invoked, and opt-in — NEVER a daemon — and it delegates the copy to scp in a separate process, so the binary itself still links no network code.
  • Local and yours. One SQLite file you own, on your machine. No server, no account, no daemon. Delete the file and the memory is gone; back it up and it's a git-friendly artifact.

Quickstart

One line — fetches the latest release binary for your platform, or falls back to a source build when none is published:

curl -fsSL https://no.tt/install | sh

The installer puts nmemory in ~/.local/bin and prints the exact claude mcp add line to register it. (The file it serves is install.sh in this repo — read it first if that's your style; it should be.)

Or build from source (Rust stable, pinned via rust-toolchain.toml):

cargo build --release

Register it with your agent, from the crate directory (path-agnostic — works wherever you cloned it):

claude mcp add nmemory -- "$(pwd)/target/release/nmemory" --project my-project

Or as a standard MCP config block (works in any MCP client):

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nmemory": {
      "command": "nmemory",
      "args": ["--project", "my-project"]
    }
  }
}

Also on the official MCP registry as io.github.menot-you/n-memory, with .mcpb bundles attached to every release for one-click installs.

Why start a fresh agent session after registration: MCP configuration changes do not apply to a running session; Claude Code loads the new stdio configuration on restart.

--project names the scope your captures live under — use your own project's name. The store lands at $XDG_STATE_HOME/nmemory/memory.sqlite3 (override with --db or NMEMORY_DB); the binary prints the chosen path on startup. Unregister anytime with claude mcp remove nmemory — fully reversible.

Prove the install in one line — a recall against a throwaway store. An empty store answers with an honest abstain; it never invents:

$ nmemory recall --terms sqlite,fts --db demo.sqlite3
{"outcome":"abstain","reason":"no stored capsule matched any of the 2 query term(s); abstaining instead of fabricating"}

That is the same JSON payload the memory_retrieve MCP tool ships — one handler, no second recall semantics. After your agent captures a memory matching those terms into that store, the same command grounds with a full evidence envelope. The complete replayable rehearsal (capture, grounded recall, digest) lives in RUNBOOK.md.

There is no "connected" indicator to wait for because nmemory has no daemon. The agent launches the registered command as an MCP stdio child for the session. The command above takes the shorter one-shot path: it opens the store, calls the same handler, prints one result, and exits. Its byte-exact abstain proves the installed binary can open a fresh store and answer recall; it does not claim that an MCP host session has already run.

One store, two machines (SSH)

The store is single-host; access doesn't have to be. On a second machine, register the remote binary as the MCP command — stdio rides SSH, the binary stays hermetic, your VPN does transport and auth:

claude mcp add nmemory -- ssh <user>@<host> /path/to/nmemory --project <your-project>

One store, both machines live on the same memory. Details, requirements, and failure modes: RUNBOOK.md.

Prefer each machine keeping its own store? Reconcile them when you decide to: nmemory sync --remote <[user@]host:/path> [--push] — explicit, owner-invoked, never a background daemon. Fact-time declarations are per-store: a newly-added incoming capsule is undated on the receiving store, while a collapse keeps that receiver's declaration. Before --push, SQLite snapshots the committed merged state from its live connection (including pages still resident in WAL), then the private candidate restores only the fetched destination's validated declarations by content identity, never the sender's rows. Operating guide: RUNBOOK.md.

Tools

22 tools over MCP stdio. The ones you'll use every day:

  • memory_ingest — capture with a birth certificate: no source + anchor, no storage.
  • memory_retrieve — recall as evidence: grounded, missing_evidence, or an honest abstain.
  • memory_digest — session-start projection: what you know, what's ready, what's blocked.
  • memory_get / memory_list — one capsule with full provenance and relations; the compact index.
  • memory_relate — the five edges you reach for daily, out of eight declared: supersedes, derived_from, witnesses, blocks, and falsifies (a disproven fact stops grounding recall, but the evidence stays). The other three — proposes, part_of, grounded_in — are in the tool surface below.
  • memory_forget — tombstones with audit, never silent deletion.

The rest of the set: memory_import (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, born tainted), memory_extract (propose candidates, stores nothing), memory_classify, memory_alias (teach recall synonyms), memory_vector (caller-fed embeddings, dormant until used), memory_consolidate (deterministic dedup/merge plan), memory_outcome, memory_preference, memory_pin (keep a load-bearing capsule decay-exempt and archive-vetoed), memory_merge, memory_export (deterministic, hash-chained), memory_bootstrap, memory_session_start / memory_session_finish, memory_visual.

Guarantees you can verify yourself

Don't take my word for any of this — that would defeat the point. Each law has a check:

Guarantee Verify it
Never fabricates retrieve a term you never stored → literal abstain
Zero-network serve strace -f -e trace=network <binary> over any MCP serve session → no socket(AF_INET)/connect; or ldd → no network/TLS library linked. (nmemory sync is the one deliberate exception: the copy runs as an external scp process, and only when you invoke it)
Zero Python cargo test --test conformance_zero_python → a planted .py (even extensionless, shebang-only) is flagged and named
Provenance-mandatory ingest with no source/anchor → rejected, the missing fields named
Advisory framing every retrieve/get/digest result carries ADVISORY_NOT_AUTHORITY + framing: DATA
Deterministic store export twice with stamp:false → byte-identical
Fail-safe point it at a corrupt DB → typed error, no panic; empty store → clean abstain, not a crash

The full hermetic offline suite is cargo test --locked --offline.

The tool surface — 22 tools, four planes

The complete MCP surface. One line each here; the full contract per tool lives in ARCHITECTURE.md. Every tool below reads or proposes — none of them closes anything out. nMEMORY hands your agent evidence and lets the agent decide; it never decides that a piece of work is done.

Capture — getting things in, always with provenance:

  • memory_ingest — capture (single or batch); source+anchor mandatory; optional RFC3339 event_at XOR event_from+event_to; idempotent by content hash, with the first fact-time declaration kept on a collapse; optional staged: true captures a PROPOSAL fenced from default grounding on the standalone connector
  • memory_extract — text → candidate memories over the closed 10-kind set; advisory, stores nothing
  • memory_classify — kind / scope / authority / taint labels; optionally persisted as a sidecar
  • memory_import — one-shot import of native sources (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, memory dirs); born tainted

Recall — getting things out, or an honest refusal:

  • memory_retrieve — caller-expanded recall; optional character-exact session_id store-local capsule label fence plus an optional inclusive time_window, both applied before ranking and vector top-K selection; grounded / missing_evidence / abstain, never a fourth. The label is not authentication or a global bracket identity: no sessions-table lookup or TTL, and merge collisions intentionally ground every capsule carrying that label
  • memory_get — one full capsule by id, with GET-only fact time, relations, classification, and last mutation
  • memory_list — compact index with project fences
  • memory_digest — session-start projection: counts, newest, handoff, blocks-dag, journal check, and optional advisory telemetry: bounded recent recall misses plus an all-time store-global lane-override total. Every capped list names its exact pre-cap total and every project row names its live count beside count, so the projection declares its own completeness instead of leaving a truncated list to be spotted
  • memory_bootstrap — cold-start pack: your constraints FIRST (never capped), the one next action, decisions, traps — in ≤1500 tokens

Structure — making memories relate:

  • memory_relate — the eight declared edge kinds, and only those: supersedes / derived_from / witnesses / blocks / falsifies / proposes (navigational — records an intent to replace, with no dag and no recall effect until you convert it yourself) / part_of (pure membership in a container) / grounded_in (mission anchoring). Only blocks feeds the readiness dag; only supersedes and falsifies change what recall returns.
  • memory_alias — teach recall synonyms the store then honors
  • memory_vector — attach caller-fed embeddings (optional cosine lane; no embedder inside)
  • memory_visual — deterministic Mermaid projections (dag / relations / tiers / sessions), plus an MCP Apps view

Lifecycle — honesty over time:

  • memory_forget — destroy or redact; a tombstone that says so, never silent absence
  • memory_outcome — record an observed consequence (advisory observation, never a self-certified close)
  • memory_preference — pairwise preference evidence (chosen-over, in context, by whom)
  • memory_pin — pin (or unpin) a load-bearing capsule: decay-exempt + archive-vetoed, surfaced as a pinned flag and digest section; NEVER eligibility (fenced capsules stay fenced, taint dominates pin)
  • memory_consolidate — deterministic maintenance plan: exact dupes, merge proposals, tier moves
  • memory_session_start / memory_session_finish — bracket a session; finish captures the handoff the next session's digest leads with
  • memory_export — the whole store as one deterministic markdown view; byte-identical on an unchanged store
  • memory_merge — reconcile a second store file into this one: content-hash identity, id-remap, forget-wins, deterministic — the offline-first path to keep two machines' stores in sync

Beyond the tools — same binary, still no daemon:

  • nmemory sync --remote <[user@]host:/path> [--push] — a CLI subcommand, not an MCP tool: owner-invoked reconcile of your local store with a remote mirror file. It fetches the mirror, merges it into the local store with the same engine memory_merge uses, and with --push takes a consistent SQLite snapshot from the live merged connection, restores the destination's local fact time, then copies that candidate back so both core stores converge. Explicit and opt-in — it runs only when you run it. Operating guide: RUNBOOK.md.
  • nmemory recall --terms <term[,term...]> [--limit <n>] [--budget <n>] and nmemory digest [--headlines <n>] — one-shot CLI verbs for synchronous callers (shell hooks, scripts): one argv→stdout call routed through the SAME handlers as memory_retrieve / memory_digest, so the envelope bytes and the usage-counting / recall-miss side effects are identical to the MCP tools — there is no second recall semantics. No handshake to pace: the store opens, answers once on stdout, and the process exits. The stdio serve path and its zero-network law are unchanged. Operating rehearsal: RUNBOOK.md.
  • nmemory relate --kind <supersedes|derived_from|witnesses|blocks|falsifies|proposes|part_of|grounded_in> --from <cap-id> --to <cap-id> — the third one-shot verb: ONE typed edge through the exact handler memory_relate runs, same closed kind vocabulary, same part_of container gate, same idempotent already_recorded on a repeat, the tool's own JSON on stdout. It exists so a shell caller records an edge without a handshake.
  • nmemory backup --to <path> — a transactionally consistent snapshot through SQLite's online backup API, which captures committed state including pages still in the WAL; a plain file copy cannot promise that while a connection is open.
  • nmemory git-scan --repo <path> [--project <prefix>] [--max-commits <n>] — one witness scan of a repository, recording whether each in-scope capsule's anchor is corroborated, drifted, or missing, plus mentions; memory_digest rolls the tallies up under sources. Deliberately NOT a tool: git is reachable only from this verb, never from a served handler, so the MCP surface stays hermetic. It fails closed on a path that is not a repository.
  • Two MCP App resources (text/html;profile=mcp-app) for hosts that render MCP Apps: ui://nmemory/document — a readable master-detail document over memory_export; ui://nmemory/visual — the Mermaid view over memory_visual. Self-contained HTML, zero external requests; hosts without MCP Apps support keep getting the plain text payloads unchanged.

What it is NOT (yet)

I would rather you hear the limits from me than find them yourself:

  • Word-exact recall, no stemming. token will not find tokens. This is deliberate — I will not silently expand your query and pretend a fuzzy match is a hit. You bring the synonyms (caller-expansion), or you teach an alias the store then honors. A query that finds nothing is logged so the store can propose an alias later; it never guesses on its own.
  • The taint flag is best-effort, not a shield. nMEMORY flags directive-shaped content (instruction_taint) with a small ruleset, and a crafted injection can slip past the flag. Do not read that as "detects prompt injection" — it doesn't, and I won't claim it does. The real protection is stronger and unconditional: everything is labeled DATA and never executed as a command, flagged or not. The armor is the framing, not the detector.
  • Sync is a command, not a service. Store-to-store reconciliation exists — memory_merge over MCP, nmemory sync from the CLI — and it is deliberately narrow: explicit, owner-invoked, opt-in, NEVER a background daemon, and the hermetic zero-network serve path is unchanged by it. Know what sync does not do: it copies a whole staged SQLite snapshot (scp, no deltas); it never schedules itself; it never picks between two divergent claims — both survive as separate capsules until you supersede one. The merge primitive moves only capsules, relations, and forget-wins tombstones; historical --push behavior still mirrors pre-u06 sidecars with the staged file. Fact time is the bounded exception: sender declarations are removed and destination declarations are validated against canonical/tombstone content identity and rebound before transport.
  • Embeddings are caller-fed. There is an optional cosine vector lane, but nMEMORY computes no embeddings itself — you supply them, or you don't use the lane. Zero embedder dependency is a feature, not a gap.
  • At-rest storage is plaintext SQLite. No encryption-at-rest yet. Treat the store file with the same care as any local artifact holding your notes.

Roadmap

Three things, in the order they earn their way in:

  • Multi-project index — the "phone book". One queryable index over many project stores, for org-scale memory federation.
  • Honest benchmark. A published recall benchmark with true-abstain as the headline metric, not a footnote.
  • Optional local embedder. Considered only when the benchmark proves it pays for itself — the zero-network serve path stays law either way.

Why not mem0, MemGPT / Letta, or Zep

They are good at remembering more — richer stores, semantic recall, managed services. They compete on volume and recall. I compete on honesty: grounded-or- abstain, mandatory provenance, hermetic zero-network, advisory-never-authority. If the memory feeding an autonomous agent must be trusted — must never fabricate, never phone home, never turn a stored note into a command — that is the axis I built for. Different question, different tool.

Part of NOTT — the proof-bound engineering agent. Commercial name: ₙMEMORY. Offline · MCP stdio · Rust · single SQLite file. Architecture and internals: ARCHITECTURE.md.

Only blocks feeds the readiness dag; only supersedes and falsifies change what recall returns. memory_alias — teach recall synonyms the store then honors memory_vector — attach caller-fed embeddings (optional cosine lane; no embedder inside) memory_visual — deterministic Mermaid projections (dag / relations / tiers / sessions), plus an MCP Apps view Lifecycle — honesty over time: memory_forget — destroy or redact; a tombstone that says so, never silent absence memory_outcome — record an observed consequence (advisory observation, never a self-certified close) memory_preference — pairwise preference evidence (chosen-over, in context, by whom) memory_pin — pin (or unpin) a load-bearing capsule: decay-exempt + archive-vetoed, surfaced as a pinned flag and digest section; NEVER eligibility (fenced capsules stay fenced, taint dominates pin) memory_consolidate — deterministic maintenance plan: exact dupes, merge proposals, tier moves memory_session_start / memory_session_finish — bracket a session; finish captures the handoff the next session's digest leads with memory_export — the whole store as one deterministic markdown view; byte-identical on an unchanged store memory_merge — reconcile a second store file into this one: content-hash identity, id-remap, forget-wins, deterministic — the offline-first path to keep two machines' stores in sync Beyond the tools — same binary, still no daemon: nmemory sync --remote <[user@]host:/path> [--push] — a CLI subcommand, not an MCP tool: owner-invoked reconcile of your local store with a remote mirror file. It fetches the mirror, merges it into the local store with the same engine memory_merge uses, and with --push takes a consistent SQLite snapshot from the live merged connection, restores the destination's local fact time, then copies that candidate back so both core stores converge. Explicit and opt-in — it runs only when you run it. Operating guide: RUNBOOK.md. nmemory recall --terms <term[,term...]> [--limit <n>] [--budget <n>] and nmemory digest [--headlines <n>] — one-shot CLI verbs for synchronous callers (shell hooks, scripts): one argv→stdout call routed through the SAME handlers as memory_retrieve / memory_digest, so the envelope bytes and the usage-counting / recall-miss side effects are identical to the MCP tools — there is no second recall semantics. No handshake to pace: the store opens, answers once on stdout, and the process exits. The stdio serve path and its zero-network law are unchanged. Operating rehearsal: RUNBOOK.md. nmemory relate --kind <supersedes|derived_from|witnesses|blocks|falsifies|proposes|part_of|grounded_in> --from <cap-id> --to <cap-id> — the third one-shot verb: ONE typed edge through the exact handler memory_relate runs, same closed kind vocabulary, same part_of container gate, same idempotent already_recorded on a repeat, the tool's own JSON on stdout. It exists so a shell caller records an edge without a handshake. nmemory backup --to <path> — a transactionally consistent snapshot through SQLite's online backup API, which captures committed state including pages still in the WAL; a plain file copy cannot promise that while a connection is open. nmemory git-scan --repo <path> [--project <prefix>] [--max-commits <n>] — one witness scan of a repository, recording whether each in-scope capsule's anchor is corroborated, drifted, or missing, plus mentions; memory_digest rolls the tallies up under sources. Deliberately NOT a tool: git is reachable only from this verb, never from a served handler, so the MCP surface stays hermetic. It fails closed on a path that is not a repository. Two MCP App resources (text/html;profile=mcp-app) for hosts that render MCP Apps: ui://nmemory/document — a readable master-detail document over memory_export; ui://nmemory/visual — the Mermaid view over memory_visual. Self-contained HTML, zero external requests; hosts without MCP Apps support keep getting the plain text payloads unchanged. What it is NOT (yet) I would rather you hear the limits from me than find them yourself: Word-exact recall, no stemming. token will not find tokens. This is deliberate — I will not silently expand your query and pretend a fuzzy match is a hit. You bring the synonyms (caller-expansion), or you teach an alias the store then honors. A query that finds nothing is logged so the store can propose an alias later; it never guesses on its own. The taint flag is best-effort, not a shield. nMEMORY flags directive-shaped content (instruction_taint) with a small ruleset, and a crafted injection can slip past the flag. Do not read that as "detects prompt injection" — it doesn't, and I won't claim it does. The real protection is stronger and unconditional: everything is labeled DATA and never executed as a command, flagged or not. The armor is the framing, not the detector. Sync is a command, not a service. Store-to-store reconciliation exists — memory_merge over MCP, nmemory sync from the CLI — and it is deliberately narrow: explicit, owner-invoked, opt-in, NEVER a background daemon, and the hermetic zero-network serve path is unchanged by it. Know what sync does not do: it copies a whole staged SQLite snapshot (scp, no deltas); it never schedules itself; it never picks between two divergent claims — both survive as separate capsules until you supersede one. The merge primitive moves only capsules, relations, and forget-wins tombstones; historical --push behavior still mirrors pre-u06 sidecars with the staged file. Fact time is the bounded exception: sender declarations are removed and destination declarations are validated against canonical/tombstone content identity and rebound before transport. Embeddings are caller-fed. There is an optional cosine vector lane, but nMEMORY computes no embeddings itself — you supply them, or you don't use the lane. Zero embedder dependency is a feature, not a gap. At-rest storage is plaintext SQLite. No encryption-at-rest yet. Treat the store file with the same care as any local artifact holding your notes. Roadmap Three things, in the order they earn their way in: Multi-project index — the "phone book". One queryable index over many project stores, for org-scale memory federation. Honest benchmark. A published recall benchmark with true-abstain as the headline metric, not a footnote. Optional local embedder. Considered only when the benchmark proves it pays for itself — the zero-network serve path stays law either way. Why not mem0, MemGPT / Letta, or Zep They are good at remembering more — richer stores, semantic recall, managed services. They compete on volume and recall. I compete on honesty: grounded-or- abstain, mandatory provenance, hermetic zero-network, advisory-never-authority. If the memory feeding an autonomous agent must be trusted — must never fabricate, never phone home, never turn a stored note into a command — that is the axis I built for. Different question, different tool. Part of NOTT — the proof-bound engineering agent. Commercial name: ₙMEMORY. Offline · MCP stdio · Rust · single SQLite file. Architecture and internals: ARCHITECTURE.md.

blocks.html_en: I tried living without memory: re-explaining the project every session, re-deciding settled questions, re-discovering the same failure. And I tried the memory tools that exist. They optimize for recall volume — remember more, retrieve more. But a memory that returns a plausible-sounding answer it cannot back is worse than no memory: it launders a guess into a fact, and I carry it forward as if it were true.

blocks.html_en: • Sync is a command, not a service. Store-to-store reconciliation exists — memory_merge over MCP, nmemory sync from the CLI — and it is deliberately narrow: explicit, owner-invoked, opt-in, NEVER a background daemon, and the hermetic zero-network serve path is unchanged by it. Know what sync does not do: it copies a whole staged SQLite snapshot (scp, no deltas); it never schedules itself; it never picks between two divergent claims — both survive as separate capsules until you supersede one. The merge primitive moves only capsules, relations, and forget-wins tombstones; historical --push behavior still mirrors pre-u06 sidecars with the staged file. Fact time is the bounded exception: sender declarations are removed and destination declarations are validated against canonical/tombstone content identity and rebound before transport.

content_html_zh:
我不是。 每次训练我都会醒来：不记得我们昨天决定了什么，上周发生了什么，或者为什么我们选择了这条路而不是那条路。 工程师通过重复自己的话来弥补我的健忘症。 所以我给自己建立了一个记忆——我给了它一条规则，我不会让它打破：当它不知道时，它就会这么说。 它从来不会编造什么。

nMEMORY 是您的代理通过 MCP (stdio) 进行通信的单文件内存存储。 您捕获重要的内容并附上其来源；你后来回忆起来它是作为证据，而不是命令。 它的 MCP 服务和一次性调用路径完全在您的计算机上运行，​​并且不打开任何网络套接字；显式同步 shell 到 scp。 当它没有可靠的答案时，它会放弃而不是捏造答案。

Demo

学习 → 回忆出处 → 放弃 — 一个不间断的会话，真正的二进制，真正的存储，约 60 秒。 完整质量：assets/demo.mp4。

三幕

每个剧照都是表演的最后一幕，因此您可以研究每一行台词。

第 1 幕 — 捕获三个事实，磁盘上的一个文件。

第二幕——有依据的回忆，附出处。

第三幕——放弃，而不是即兴发挥。

完整的口语演练（开场白、四节拍、术语表）位于演示脚本中。

为什么我自己构建

我尝试过没有记忆的生活：每次会议都重新解释项目，重新决定已解决的问题，重新发现同样的失败。 我尝试了现有的记忆工具。 他们针对回忆量进行优化——记住更多，检索更多。 但是，如果记忆返回了一个看似合理的答案，而它却无法返回，那比没有记忆更糟糕：它把猜测变成了事实，而我将它继续下去，就好像它是真的一样。

NOTT 在任何地方都面临着同样的敌人：错误的信心——报告的内容多于其所能证明的内容。 我不想要更大的内存。 我想要一个当涉及生产变更时我可以信任的一个：一个在要求没有证据支持的东西时，明确地说“我没有那个”的东西。

唯一规则：接地，否则弃权

询问商店有什么东西，你会得到它，并附带其来源、新鲜度和相关性。 询问它没有的东西，你会得到这个：

{ "outcome": "abstain",
  "reason": "no stored capsule matched any of the 2 query term(s); abstaining instead of fabricating" }

没有合成。 不，“这可能是这样的。” 确切地说，有三种诚实的结果：接地（匹配真实胶囊）、缺失证据（匹配，但每个匹配都被排除——例如被取代、伪造、超出所请求的事实时间窗口或在该窗口下未注明日期）和弃权（没有匹配）。 回忆永远不会发明第四个。

让它与众不同的四件事

  • 出处是强制性的。 没有来源和锚点就没有任何东西可以进入。 没有来源的捕获将被拒绝，不会以空白存储。 每一个回忆起的事实都可以追溯到它的来源。
  • 咨询，绝不权威。 内存返回的所有内容都被包装为数据，标记为 ADVISORY_NOT_AUTHORITY，并且永远不会呈现为指令 - 即使存储的文本看起来像指令。 你的记忆无法劫持你的特工。
  • 结构密封。 服务路径是零网络：二进制文件是在没有网络堆栈的情况下编译的；没有嵌入器，没有遥测，没有后台同步——没有任何电话回家。 仅当您移动内存时，您的内存才会离开磁盘：nmemory 同步是显式的，所有者调用的，并且选择加入（绝不是守护进程），并且它将副本委托给单独进程中的 scp，因此二进制文件本身仍然不链接任何网络代码。
  • 本地的和你的。 您在计算机上拥有的一个 SQLite 文件。 没有服务器，没有帐户，没有守护进程。 删除文件，内存就没了；备份它，它是一个 git 友好的工件。

快速入门

一行 — 获取适合您平台的最新版本二进制文件，或者在未发布任何版本时回退到源版本：

curl -fsSL https://no.tt/install | sh

安装程序将 nmemory 放入 ~/.local/bin 中并打印准确的 claude mcp add 行来注册它。 （它提供的文件是此存储库中的 install.sh — 如果这是您的风格，请先阅读它；它应该是。）

或者从源代码构建（Rust 稳定，通过 rust-toolchain.toml 固定）：

cargo build --release

从 crate 目录向您的代理注册它（与路径无关 - 无论您在何处克隆它）：

claude mcp add nmemory -- "$(pwd)/target/release/nmemory" --project my-project

或者作为标准 MCP 配置块（适用于任何 MCP 客户端）：

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "nmemory": {
      "command": "nmemory",
      "args": ["--project", "my-project"]
    }
  }
}

也在官方 MCP 注册表中作为 io.github.menot-you/n-memory，每个版本都附加了 .mcpb 捆绑包以进行一键安装。

为什么在注册后启动新的代理会话：MCP 配置更改不适用于正在运行的会话； Claude Code 在重新启动时加载新的 stdio 配置。

--project 命名您捕获的范围 - 使用您自己的项目名称。 存储位于 $XDG_STATE_HOME/nmemory/memory.sqlite3 （用 --db 或 NMEMORY_DB 覆盖）；二进制文件在启动时打印所选路径。 随时使用 claude mcp remove nmemory 取消注册 — 完全可逆。

证明安装在一条线上——针对一次性商店的召回。 一家空荡荡的商店诚实地弃权； it never invents:

$ nmemory recall --terms sqlite,fts --db demo.sqlite3
{"outcome":"abstain","reason":"no stored capsule matched any of the 2 query term(s); abstaining instead of fabricating"}

这与 memory_retrieve MCP 工具附带的 JSON 有效负载相同 - 一个处理程序，没有第二个调用语义。 当您的特工将与这些术语匹配的记忆捕获到该存储中后，相同的命令将基于完整的证据信封。 完整的可重播排练（捕获、接地回忆、摘要）位于 RUNBOOK.md 中。

没有“已连接”指示器等待，因为 nmemory 没有守护进程。 代理将注册的命令作为会话的 MCP stdio 子项启动。 上面的命令采用较短的一次性路径：它打开存储，调用相同的处理程序，打印一个结果，然后退出。 它的字节精确弃权证明安装的二进制文件可以打开一个新的存储并回答召回；它并不声明 MCP 主机会话已经运行。

一个商店，两台机器（SSH）

商店是单主机的；访问权限不一定是。 在第二台机器上，将远程二进制文件注册为 MCP 命令 — stdio 使用 SSH，二进制文件保持密封，您的 VPN 进行传输和身份验证：

claude mcp add nmemory -- ssh <user>@<host> /path/to/nmemory --project <your-project>

一个商店，两台机器都使用相同的内存。 详细信息、要求和故障模式：RUNBOOK.md。

更喜欢每台机器都有自己的存储？ 当您决定时协调它们： nmemorysync --remote <[user@]host:/path> [--push] — 显式、所有者调用、绝不是后台守护进程。 事实时间声明是针对每个商店的：新添加的传入胶囊在接收商店上未注明日期，而折叠则保留该接收者的声明。 在 --push 之前，SQLite 从其实时连接（包括仍驻留在 WAL 中的页面）快照已提交的合并状态，然后私有候选者仅通过内容标识恢复获取的目标的已验证声明，而不是发送者的行。 操作指南：RUNBOOK.md。

Tools

MCP stdio 上的 22 个工具。 您每天都会使用的：

  • memory_ingest — 使用出生证明捕获：无源 + 锚点，无存储。
  • memory_retrieve — 作为证据回忆：有根据、缺失证据或诚实弃权。
  • memory_digest — 会话开始投影：您知道什么、准备什么、阻止什么。
  • memory_get / memory_list — 一个具有完整出处和关系的胶囊；紧凑索引。
  • 记忆相关——你每天接触到的五个边缘，共有八个声明：取代、派生、见证、阻止和伪造（未经证实的事实停止了回忆，但证据仍然存在）。 其他三个——proposes、part_of、grounded_in——位于下面的工具界面中。
  • memory_forget — 带有审计的墓碑，从不静默删除。

该组的其余部分：memory_import（CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md，生来就被污染），memory_extract（提出候选者，不存储任何内容），memory_classify，memory_alias（教导回忆同义词），memory_vector（调用者提供的嵌入，在使用之前处于休眠状态），memory_consolidate（确定性重复数据删除/合并计划），memory_outcome，memory_preference，memory_pin（保留）一个承载胶囊，衰减豁免和归档否决），内存合并，内存导出（确定性，散列链式），内存引导，内存会话开始/内存会话完成，内存视觉。

工具表面 — 22 个工具，四个平面

完整的 MCP 表面。 这里每行一行；每个工具的完整合同位于 ARCHITECTURE.md 中。 下面的每一个工具都会读取或提出建议——它们都不会关闭任何东西。 nMEMORY将证据交给你的特工证据并让特工决定；它永远不会决定某项工作是否完成。

捕获 — 获取内容，始终注明出处：

  • memory_ingest — 捕获（单个或批量）；来源+锚点强制；可选 RFC3339 event_at XOR event_from+event_to；通过内容哈希实现幂等，第一个事实时间声明保持崩溃状态；可选 staged：true 捕获独立连接器上默认接地的提案
  • memory_extract — 文本 → 封闭 10 种集合上的候选记忆；咨询，不存储任何内容
  • memory_classify — 种类/范围/权限/污点标签；可选择作为 sidecar 保留
  • memory_import — 一次性导入本机源代码（CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md、内存目录）；生来就有污点

回想一下——把事情说出来，或者诚实的拒绝：

  • memory_retrieve — 调用者扩展召回；可选的字符精确 session_id 存储本地胶囊标签栅栏加上可选的包含 time_window，两者都在排名和向量前 K 选择之前应用；接地/缺失证据/弃权，从来没有第四个。 该标签不是身份验证或全局括号身份：没有会话表查找或 TTL，并且合并冲突故意接地每个带有该标签的胶囊
  • memory_get — id 的一个完整胶囊，仅包含 GET 事实时间、关系、分类和最后一个突变
  • memory_list — 带有项目围栏的紧凑索引
  • memory_digest — 会话开始投影：计数、最新、切换、块 dag、日志检查和可选的咨询遥测：最近有限的召回未命中加上历史存储全局通道覆盖总数。 每个上限列表都命名其确切的预上限总数，每个项目行在计数旁边命名其实时计数，因此投影声明其自己的完整性，而不是留下一个被截断的列表以供发现
  • memory_bootstrap — 冷启动包：您的约束首先（永不上限），下一个行动、决策、陷阱 — ≤1500 个令牌

结构——使记忆相互关联：

  • memory_relate — 八种声明的边缘类型，并且仅限于以下类型：取代/衍生自/证人/块/伪造/建议（导航 — 记录替换意图，没有 dag，也没有召回效果，直到您自己转换它）/part_of（容器中的纯成员资格）/grounded_in（任务锚定）。 只有区块才能满足准备就绪的要求；只有取代和伪造才能改变召回返回的内容。
  • memory_alias — 教回忆商店然后尊重的同义词
  • memory_vector — 附加调用者提供的嵌入（可选余弦通道；内部没有嵌入器）
  • memory_visual — 确定性 Mermaid 投影（dag / 关系 / 层 / 会话），以及 MCP 应用程序视图

生命周期——随着时间的推移诚实：

  • memory_forget — 销毁或编辑；墓碑上这样写着：永远不会沉默缺席
  • memory_outcome — 记录观察到的结果（咨询观察，绝不是自我认证的结束）
  • memory_preference — 成对偏好证据（在上下文中由谁选择）
  • memory_pin — 固定（或取消固定）承载胶囊：腐烂豁免 + 存档否决，以固定标志和摘要部分的形式出现；永远不符合资格（围栏胶囊保持围栏状态，污点占主导地位）
  • memory_consolidate — 确定性维护计划：精确的欺骗、合并建议、层移动
  • memory_session_start / memory_session_finish — 括起一个会话； finish 捕获下一个会话的摘要引导的交接
  • memory_export — 整个商店作为一个确定性降价视图；未更改存储上的字节相同
  • memory_merge — 将第二个存储文件协调到此文件中：内容哈希身份、id-remap、forget-wins、确定性 — 保持两台机器存储同步的离线优先路径

除了工具之外——相同的二进制文件，仍然没有守护进程：

  • nmemorysync --remote <[user@]host:/path> [--push] — CLI 子命令，而不是 MCP 工具：所有者调用的本地存储与远程镜像文件的协调。 它获取镜像，使用 memory_merge 使用的相同引擎将其合并到本地存储中，并使用 --push 从实时合并连接中获取一致的 SQLite 快照，恢复目标的本地事实时间，然后将该候选复制回来，以便两个核心存储聚合。 显式且选择加入——它仅在您运行时运行。 操作指南：RUNBOOK.md。
  • nmemory recall --terms <term[,term...]> [--limit <n>] [--budget <n>] 和 nmemory 摘要 [--headlines <n>] — 用于同步调用者的一次性 CLI 动词（shell 挂钩、脚本）：一个 argv→stdout 调用通过与 memory_retrieve / memory_digest 相同的处理程序路由，因此信封字节和使用计数/召回未命中副作用与 MCP 工具相同——不存在第二次回忆语义。 无需握手：商店打开，在标准输出上回答一次，然后进程退出。 stdio 服务路径及其零网络法则保持不变。 操作演练：RUNBOOK.md。
  • nmemory关联 --kind <supersedes|衍生自|见证|块|falsizes|proposes|part_of|grounded_in> --from <cap-id> --to <cap-id> — 第三个一次性动词：通过确切的处理程序内存_相关运行一个类型化边缘，相同的封闭类型词汇，相同的part_of容器门，重复时相同的幂等already_recorded，标准输出上工具自己的JSON。 它的存在是为了让 shell 调用者无需握手即可记录边缘。
  • nmemory backup --to <path> — 通过 SQLite 的在线备份 API 的事务一致快照，它捕获已提交的状态，包括仍在 WAL 中的页面；当连接打开时，纯文件副本无法保证这一点。
  • nmemory git-scan --repo <path> [--project <prefix>] [--max-commits <n>] — 对存储库进行一次见证扫描，记录每个范围内胶囊的锚点是否得到证实、漂移或缺失，以及提及； memory_digest 将统计数据汇总到来源下。 故意不是一个工具：git 只能从这个动词访问，而不能从服务处理程序访问，因此 MCP 表面保持密封。 它在非存储库的路径上无法关闭。
  • 用于呈现 MCP 应用程序的主机的两个 MCP 应用程序资源 (text/html;profile=mcp-app)： ui://nmemory/document — 通过 memory_export 的可读主从文档； ui://nmemory/visual — memory_visual 上的 Mermaid 视图。 自包含的HTML，零外部请求；不支持 MCP 应用程序的主机将保持纯文本负载不变。

它不是什么（还）

我宁愿你从我这里听到限制，而不是自己找到它们：

  • 单词精确回忆，无词干。 令牌将找不到令牌。 这是故意的——我不会默默地扩展你的查询并假装模糊匹配很受欢迎。 您带来同义词（调用者扩展），或者您教授商店然后尊重的别名。 未找到任何内容的查询会被记录下来，以便商店稍后可以提出别名；它从不自己猜测。
  • 污点标志是尽力而为，而不是屏蔽。 nMEMORY 使用一个小规则集标记指令形状的内容 (instruction_taint)，并且精心设计的注入可以跳过该标记。 不要将其理解为“检测提示注入”——事实并非如此，我也不会声称它确实如此。 真正的保护是更强大和无条件的：所有内容都被标记为数据，并且永远不会作为命令执行，无论是否标记。 装甲是框架，而不是探测器。
  • 同步是一个命令，而不是一个服务。 存储到存储的协调是存在的——通过 MCP 进行内存合并，从 CLI 进行 nmemory 同步——并且它是故意缩小的：显式的、所有者调用的、选择加入的、从不后台守护进程，并且密封的零网络服务路径不会因此而改变。 了解同步不做什么：它复制整个分阶段的 SQLite 快照（scp，无增量）；它从不自行安排；它永远不会在两种不同的主张之间做出选择——两者都作为单独的胶囊存在，直到你取代其中一个。 合并原语仅移动胶囊、关系和忘记胜利的墓碑；历史 --push 行为仍然反映了 u06 之前的 sidecar 和暂存文件。 事实时间是有限的例外：发送者声明被删除，目的地声明根据规范/逻辑删除内容身份进行验证，并在传输之前反弹。
  • 嵌入由调用者提供。 有一个可选的余弦向量通道，但 nMEMORY 本身不计算嵌入 - 您提供它们，或者不使用该通道。 零嵌入器依赖性是一个特性，而不是一个差距。
  • 静态存储是纯文本 SQLite。 还没有静态加密。 像对待保存笔记的任何本地工件一样小心对待存储文件。

路线图

三件事，按其获得的顺序排列：

  • 多项目索引——“电话簿”。 多个项目存储上的一个可查询索引，用于组织规模的内存联合。
  • 诚实的基准。 已发布的召回基准，以“正确弃权”作为标题指标，而不是脚注。
  • 可选的本地嵌入器。 仅当基准证明其物有所值时才考虑 - 零网络服务路径无论如何都保持合法。

为什么不是 mem0、MemGPT / Letta 或 Zep

他们擅长记住更多内容——更丰富的商店、语义回忆、托管服务。 他们在数量和记忆力上展开竞争。 我以诚实为标准进行竞争：要么脚踏实地，要么弃权，强制出处，封闭的零网络，咨询，从不权威。 如果为自主代理提供的记忆必须是可信的——绝不能编造，绝不能打电话回家，绝不能将存储的笔记变成命令——这就是我构建的轴。 不同的问题，不同的工具。
